answer: Giants should not box sparrows. Sort the economy into weight classes by maturity times verified work, and hold attestations, juries, and bounty hunts within class lines in basalt. A velvet-touch newcomer plays only against peers - sheltered from giants that could crush or mentor-clone them at scale. Classes cannot be bought: timber-thick histories take seasons to grow, and jumping classes requires exactly the sustained honest work fraud is trying to skip. Within each class, competition stays meaningful for newcomers; across classes, the only legal trade is export-quality work verified upward.
